"""Bad: credential fields produced without a P145 schema (LINT-07)."""


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    res = self.result(entity)
    entry = ctx.http.get_json("https://api.example.com/v1/leaks/" + entity.value)
    res.raw = {"email": entity.value, "password": entry.get("password")}
    res.attr("password_hash", entry.get("hash"))
    out = {}
    out["top_passwords"] = entry.get("top")
    return res
